questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In an adiabatic process, the state of a gas is changed from \(P_1, V_1, T_1\) to \(P_2, V_2, T_2\). Which of the following relations is correct where \(\gamma = C_p/C_v\)?
questions.explanation: For an adiabatic reversible process of an ideal gas, PV^gamma = constant.

questions.question: The work done during an isothermal expansion of 1 mole of an ideal gas from volume \(V_1\) to \(V_2\) at temperature \(T\) is:
